entities.summary: Keramat Habib Noh is an Islamic religious complex located along Palmer Road in Shenton Way within the Central Area, Singapore. The religious complex comprises a mausoleum, Maqam Habib Noh, and a mosque, Masjid Haji Muhammad Salleh, as well as a library. The complex has its origins in the 19th century and is the burial place of Habib Noh, whose tomb is still widely visited by not only locals, but also tourists from abroad. It is considered the most famous keramat in the country.
